notes: The inventory pages with Element IDs were not in the supplied pages. The standard design numbers used (3022, 3023, 3003, 3001, 4474, 4624) are best guesses from the step pictures, and 4474 and 4624 are the least certain. The chassis, seat/hood/dash body pieces and mini-doll parts are Friends-specific, so they keep descriptive lego-* type names.
The pink front bumper piece is modelled as a 1x2 plate (3023) because it could not be confirmed as a tile. It is a thin pink 1x2 piece pushed into the front of the grille.
The wheel is modelled as one piece (hub plus tyre) for simplicity.
Piece shapes and stud-level placements are read from small step pictures and are approximate. Every stud and anti-stud port is used only once.
Wheel holders are modelled as pins on the chassis, and the wheels have pin-holes. Mini-doll parts join pin to pin-hole.

Steps: 1 black chassis. 2 pink seat pieces. 3 yellow and grey plates. 4 three white bricks. 5 white hood/grille, teal and purple pieces. 6 purple 2-stud plate. 7 windscreen and pink bumper. 8 four wheels and the Emma mini-doll, which was assembled on the front page and is seated on the seat base.
Wheels are listed explicitly as four parts rather than as a repeat.
